title: Senior Plant Operations Manager
description: Lead plant operations, industrial manufacturing execution, throughput optimization, and safety compliance across heavy industrial production facilities.
details:
### Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Plant Operations Manager to lead manufacturing operations, industrial automation, and lean production workflows.

### Key Responsibilities
- Oversee daily plant operations, production scheduling, and machine utilization.
- Drive Lean Six Sigma, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and Quality Assurance standards.
- Ensure strict compliance with Industrial Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations.
- Lead workforce deployment, operational budgeting, and cross-departmental coordination.

### Requirements
- B.Tech / BE in Industrial or Mechanical Engineering.
- 8+ years of experience in manufacturing plant management or heavy industrial production.
- Demonstrated expertise in process optimization, ISO standards, and team leadership.
